plan.what: Validate the image path and set up global state
plan.fails_if: IMAGE_PATH env var missing or file does not exist

plan.what: Create a PDF containing rendered markdown and the image, store bytes in global state
plan.fails_if: Image cannot be read, PDF generation fails, or markdown rendering errors

plan.what: Output a JSON object with the PDF base64 string
plan.fails_if: globalThis.pdfBytes undefined or JSON serialization fails

notes: Maturation rubric: Render markdown text (# heading, ## subheading, - bullet items, paragraphs) alongside the embedded image. Multi-page if content exceeds one page. Use at least 2 distinct font sizes (heading larger than body).
